heading.title: Parties to Notes, Bills and Cheques.

article.title: Acceptor bound, although, indorsement forged.
article.content: An acceptor of a bill of exchange already indorsed is not relieved from liability by reason that such indorsement is forged, if he knew or had reason to believe the indorsement to be forged when he accepted the bill.
article.html:
41Acceptor bound, although, indorsement forged.

Section 41 · Chapter III · page 13 of the Act

An acceptor of a bill of exchange already indorsed is not relieved from liability by reason that such indorsement is forged, if he knew or had reason to believe the indorsement to be forged when he accepted the bill.
